title: Portugal Refining Resilience
description: Portugal Refining Resilience is a notebook-first research software repository for analysing how Portugal's petroleum-product system changed around the 2013 Sines hydrocracker expansion and the 2021 discontinuation of refining at Matosinhos. The repository combines auditable data-provenance files, a sequential notebook pipeline, reusable Python helpers, and report-readiness checks to separate documented refining-capacity events from trade-balance, import-dependence, supply-resilience, and price-transmission evidence. This initial release is structured for transparent review and reproducibility; the committed seed series is provisional and should be replaced or cross-validated by the acquisition notebooks before empirical results are treated as publication-ready.
references: Direcao-Geral de Energia e Geologia (DGEG), petroleum-product imports, exports, sales, energy balances, and fuel-price statistics.
Joint Organisations Data Initiative (JODI), Oil World Database, monthly secondary-product supply and demand series.
Eurostat nrg_cb_oil, annual oil supply, transformation, and consumption data.
European Commission Weekly Oil Bulletin, weekly consumer fuel prices with and without taxes.
Galp official disclosures, refinery event metadata for Sines and Matosinhos.
notes: Research software release. Raw downloaded source files are excluded from version control by default; transformed, reviewable seed data and provenance files are included where they are part of the auditable analysis surface.
